The only way to feel better about myself is to go out and... do it.

strings.Lo que te dices cuando algo no está bien: What you tell yourself when something isn’t right
strings.Pensamientos que quizás reconoces como t: Thoughts you may recognise as your own
strings.No tengo tiempo para esto: I don’t have time for this
strings.Lo que no tienes es más energía para seg: What you don’t have is the energy to keep living like this. You wake up tired, spend the day with your mind racing and reach the night without ever truly switching off. And still you feel you can’t stop? Ignoring yourself comes at a price too… and it gets higher every day. You don’t need more time; you need to stop putting yourself last.
strings.Yo nunca he pedido ayuda. Puedo con esto: I’ve never asked for help. I can handle this on my own
strings.Claro que puedes… llevas tiempo demostrá: Of course you can… you’ve been proving it for a long time. But inside you’re more and more exhausted, more anxious, further away from yourself. And still, something stops you asking for help, because you’re afraid of no longer being the strong one, the one who can handle everything. But look at yourself… this version of you, pushed to the limit, isn’t who you want to be either. You don’t have to break before you allow yourself support. Accepting it doesn’t make you weak; it lets you be yourself again.
strings.No es para tanto… puedo aguantar: It’s not that bad… I can cope
strings.Eso es lo que te dices mientras tu cabez: That’s what you tell yourself while your mind won’t stop, you sleep badly and every day feels heavier. You’ve got used to living like this, but that doesn’t make it normal. Coping isn’t the same as being well… it’s surviving. And deep down you know it: you don’t want this to be your life.
strings.¿Y si no me funciona?: What if it doesn’t work for me?
strings.Lo que más miedo da no es que no funcion: The scariest thing isn’t that it might not work… it’s that nothing changes. Carrying on feeling trapped, exhausted and disconnected from yourself, while on the outside everything stays the same. You’ve already tried pushing harder, demanding more of yourself, holding on longer… and it has only brought you here. Maybe it isn’t about being able to do more, but about no longer doing it alone and starting to do it differently.
strings.¿Te identificas con alguna de estas situ: Do you recognise yourself in any of these situations?
strings.Te cuesta priorizarte sin culpa: You struggle to put yourself first without guilt
strings.¿En qué momento empezaste a sentir que p: When did you start to feel that stopping meant failing?
strings.Que descansar, decir \"no\" o simplement: That resting, saying "no" or simply having had enough… made you worth less.
strings.Te pones a ti mismo en el último lugar,: You put yourself last; everything takes priority over you, while inside you’re wearing yourself out.
strings.Y aun así, cuando piensas en priorizarte: And yet, when you think about putting yourself first… the guilt kicks in.
strings.¿Por qué sientes que, hagas lo que hagas: Why do you feel that, whatever you do, it’s never enough?
strings.¿Por qué, aunque lo estés dando todo, si: Why, even when you’re giving it everything, do you still feel you’re failing?
strings.Te exiges más, aprietas más… y aun así e: You demand more of yourself, push harder… and still that voice is there, telling you you’re falling short, that you could do better.
strings.Y lo que más duele… es que empiezas a cr: And what hurts most… is that you’re starting to believe it.
strings.¿Recuerdas cómo eras antes de sentirte a: Do you remember who you were before you felt this exhausted?
strings.Antes de que todo pesara tanto… antes de: Before everything felt so heavy… before your mind never stopped.
strings.Ahora solo sobrevives el día, intentando: Now you just get through the day, trying to keep up with everything, while slowly losing yourself.
strings.Y en el fondo lo sabes… si sigues así, n: And deep down you know it… if you carry on like this, it’s not just that nothing will change… you’ll lose yourself completely.
strings.Todo lo que quizás te estás preguntando: Everything you may be wondering before taking the first step
strings.Lo más importante es que vengas con gana: The most important thing is that you come willing to explore and with an open mind. In therapy, we’ll work together to identify which situations are causing you distress, which emotional blocks you’re facing and how they’re affecting your daily life. From there, we’ll go step by step to overcome those challenges in a practical way that suits you, with tools to help you recover your emotional well-being.
strings.¿Cuánto puede durar este proceso?: How long might the process take?
strings.La duración de un proceso terapéutico no: Therapy doesn’t have to be a long process. It all depends on the situation you’re going through, your goals and how ready you are for change.
strings.En algunos casos, con una sola sesión pu: In some cases, a single session can bring emotional relief; in others, more frequent or longer-term support is needed. Sometimes you come for a specific issue, we resolve it and you no longer need to continue.
strings.Lo que sí puedo asegurarte es que si en: What I can promise is that if at any point we feel the process isn’t moving forward as it should, I’ll offer you other options or refer you to someone better placed to help. Your emotional well-being comes first.

strings.Hola Alejandro, qué tal te encuentras ah: Hi Alejandro, how are you feeling now that you’ve finished your therapy?
strings.Hola Marilo, gracias por preguntar. Ante: Hi Marilo, thanks for asking. Before I started sessions with you, I was struggling to talk to my partner about my problems and interests, and it was costing us our relationship. Thanks to the sessions, I now see problems from other points of view and I have more tools to communicate with my partner. Thank you so much for your work and all your help during the sessions. I felt truly understood, and it was very easy to open up and express myself with you.
strings.He tenido la gran suerte de contar con l: I’ve been lucky enough to have Marilò’s help at different moments in my life, which has shown me her incredible ability to explain the psychological mechanisms behind emotions and behaviours that used to confuse or upset me. She does it with great clarity, logic and calm, and with real sensitivity in approaching each topic, showing incredible empathy and inspiring trust. Her talent and vocation are undeniable, and she creates a space where you feel heard, understood and supported.
With you, from the very first step.

strings.Psicóloga Clínica con formación internac: Clinical Psychologist with international training and extensive NHS experience. I offer evidence-based therapy to children, adolescents and adults, with a strong background in neuropsychology, cognitive assessment and the management of complex cases. I have worked in adult, forensic, CAMHS and neurorehabilitation settings, across both inpatient and outpatient services. I am committed to compassionate, collaborative, high-quality, person-centred care. I am currently specialising in Schema Therapy to work with complex trauma and personality disorders.

strings.Áreas de especialización de Maria Dolore: Areas of expertise of Maria Dolores Barrios Nevado, clinical psychologist: child and adolescent mental health, forensic psychology, neuropsychology, schema therapy, online therapy and more.
strings.Con experiencia en unidades de hospitali: With experience in Tier 4 inpatient units, I offer specialist therapy for adolescents with complex trauma, PTSD, mood disorders, suicidal ideation, eating disorders, autism (ASD), OCD and first-episode psychosis. I work closely with families and multidisciplinary teams.
strings.Amplia experiencia en servicios forenses: Extensive experience in low and medium secure forensic services. I provide psychological formulation for severe mental illness, offending behaviour and psychosis, HCR-20 risk assessment, and individual and group interventions (CBTp, anger management, MBTi-based peer support).
strings.Evaluación neuropsicológica, psicoeducac: Neuropsychological assessment, psychoeducation, stress management and the development of compensatory strategies for people with acquired brain injury. Support with cognitive functions (memory, attention), emotional regulation and independence in everyday activities.
strings.Discapacidad Intelectual y Apoyo Conduct: Intellectual Disability and Positive Behaviour Support
strings.Evaluación psicológica, formulación y pl: Psychological assessment, formulation and Positive Behaviour Support (PBS) planning in adult residential services and CAMHS. I use trauma-informed, compassion-focused therapy to build emotional regulation and coping strategies.
strings.Formación aprobada por ISST en curso. Tr: ISST-approved training in progress. I work with early maladaptive schemas and their impact on personality patterns and relational dynamics in adulthood: an in-depth, reparenting-based approach for complex trauma and personality disorders.
strings.Sesiones online en inglés y español a tr: Online sessions in English and Spanish through secure platforms. Individual therapy for adults experiencing anxiety, depression, low self-esteem and post-traumatic stress disorder.
